gaia_source_id: # Curated exceptions to the label merge's mechanical rule (overlay wins on
# disagreement, docs/catalog-driver.md § 4). One row per record per identifier;
# an empty `value` keeps the spine's. `#` in the first column comments a line —
# the header stays the first line, as every committed TSV's does.
# Nearly every one of today's 137 disagreements is either a real AT-HYG
# cross-ID error the overlay corrects (Izar: AT-HYG's HR 5505 against IV/27A +
# V/50's HR 5506, and ε Boo IS HR 5506) or a resolved close pair whose two
# components the two catalogues letter oppositely — neither is the CDS join being
# wrong, which is the only thing this file is for. The full enumeration with
# dispositions is data/classic-ids/label_flips.tsv.
# Propus (η Gem, HIP 29655) is the shape to recognise: Gaia
# fits ONE source where Tycho-2 resolves two entries, and its TYC cross-match
# keys that source to the SECONDARY. IV/25 gives the record's own
# TYC 1877-1716-1 HD 42995 and the sibling TYC 1877-1716-2 HD 253820; SIMBAD
# binds source 3377072212924335488 to η Gem, which is why the record binds it
# (simbad_corroborated). The overlay reaches that source through the sibling's
# TYC alone, so it proposes 253820 as the record's only HD — no alias list, no
# sibling extra, just § 4 precedence handing a star its neighbour's number and
# folding the neighbour's own record away as a component.
# THE EIGHT RECORDS BELOW ARE THE SAME SHAPE READ THE OTHER WAY, fifteen rows
# that are a RULE's output rather than fifteen separate judgements: the record
# ships its neighbour's HD, and all four witnesses agree which component the
# record is
# (scripts/catalog/simbad/README.md § Which witness decides a close pair's HD).
# IV/25 and SIMBAD both give the record's own Tycho entry the HD below, SIMBAD's
# object for the record's own Gaia source is the component that entry names, and
# V/50 pairs the HR with it. HD and HR move together because V/50 publishes them
# as a pair; moving one alone composes a pair no catalogue prints.
# Twelve further rows the two TYC witnesses also contradict are NOT here, and
# that is the rule working: on those the record's own source is SIMBAD's object
# for the OTHER component, so the TYC cell is the crossed one and the shipped HD
# stands. ε Boo is the case — its record is Izar and its TYC is ε Boo B's.
# Each row below was checked against SIMBAD's own ident table (live, 2026-09-10)
# on both fields; the component the comment names is SIMBAD's main_id for the
# record's Gaia source.
# α Psc A (source 2517584007848935808, ships 12446 / HR 595 = α Psc B) is the
# ninth record of the rule's move set and is DELIBERATELY NOT HERE. Correcting it
# re-opens stellata-3bsf.42: promotion's twin guard fires on
# `anchorStar.bayerComponent === canonicalComp`, and the authority letters
# HD 12446 B where it letters HD 12447 A — so the moment the anchor holds A,
# the guard stops firing and the 02020+0246-AB row mints a copy of the anchor
# again (its two ends carry identical ids, position and absmag). sid 193218 was
# retired for exactly that on 2026-09-07, "reinstate only if WDS re-keys the row
# onto a genuinely separate component", and WDS has not. stellata-hooj.16.
# ^ f Eri A. Ships 24071 / HR 1189 = f Eri B. This is stellata-3bsf.52's case.
# ^ ζ¹ Cnc A. Ships 68255 = ζ¹ Cnc B, and HR 3210, which SIMBAD calls ζ² Cnc —
#   a different system. V/50 pairs 68255 with 3210, so the shipped pair is
#   internally consistent and still names two different stars.
# ^ δ Ser A. Ships 138917 / HR 5788 = δ Ser B.
# ^ κ¹ CrA. Ships 170867 / HR 6953 = κ² CrA.
# ^ κ² CrA. Ships 170868 / HR 6952 = κ¹ CrA. A MUTUAL swap with the pair above:
#   both rows move or each takes the other's surviving cell.
# ^ 12 Aqr A. Ships 200496 / HR 8058 = 12 Aqr B.
# ^ ζ² Aqr. Ships 213051 / HR 8558 = ζ¹ Aqr.
# ^ HD 330123. Ships 330122. Neither number is in V/50, so there is no HR to
#   move with it — the one record of the nine that carries a single field. No
#   Tycho entry names the freed 330122, so it reaches no manifest row and stops
#   resolving anywhere (scripts/catalog/classic-ids/label-merge/README.md
#   § What a freed number costs).
